channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Chet Holmgren | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Chet Holmgren from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Chet Holmgren
item.description:
Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Chet Holmgren:

“Chet is a really, really, really good basketball player. Basketball is like life. There are ups and downs. He works super hard. He has the right intentions. ... I expect Chet to continue to get better, just like he has done every single year.”

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Chet Holmgren, Sep 28, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Sam Presti on Chet Holmgren
item.description:
Sam Presti on Chet Holmgren:

“He needs no motivation. This is a person who is an ultra-competitor... You don't have a season like the one he had last year... He didn't play his best basketball in that series, but all of the great players in NBA history, that's what makes them great. They confront those moments.”

Sam Presti on Chet Holmgren, Sep 24, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jay Williams on Dan Hurley, Isaiah Hartenstein, Chet Holmgren, Aday Mara
item.description:
NBA Courtside:Jay Willams says OKC and the Spurs won the draft:

“They continue to put their chokehold on the NBA.What did we talk about a lot with OKC? How did Chet Holmgren play in the NBA finals? What’s going on with Isaiah Hartenstein when he had go against Wemby? That got a guy named Aday Mara who has a 7’4 wingspan, super talented can give you depth off the bench and give you an extra body to go against Wemby. How about for San Antonio for Wembanyama we talked a lot about who’s the enforcer when Kornet played in that series, now you bring a guy that brings a lot of physicality played for Dan Hurley at UConn a absolute beast on the glass.”

Jay Williams on Dan Hurley, Isaiah Hartenstein, Chet Holmgren, Aday Mara, Jun 24, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Sam Presti on Chet Holmgren
item.description:
Sam Presti on Chet Holmgren:

“Chet’s one of our guys. He’s been so impactful, he drives winning on so many different levels for us. … He didn’t have a great series. As I was saying, if you go back and look at some of the greatest players, they all have these moments where they run into defeat and struggle. He’s an underdog. We’ve seen that everywhere. He’s been questioned every time. That’s why he fits here so well. This is a guy that is intrinsically motivated. He doesn’t need things on the internet to drive his improvement.”

Sam Presti on Chet Holmgren, Jun 8, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Chandler Parsons on Victor Wembanyama, Jalen Williams, Ajay Mitchell, Chet Holmgren
item.description:
Chandler Parsons on Chet Holmgren:

“I do think there is some sort of mental block when it comes to Victor Wembanyama. I really do. I don't think it is like Space Jam, but I don't think he can take two shots in Game 7. You don't play 33 minutes and take two shots. I would rather live and die with going down with Ajay Mitchell out and Jalen Williams out. I would rather have him be 0 for 15 than one for two.”

Chandler Parsons on Victor Wembanyama, Jalen Williams, Ajay Mitchell, Chet Holmgren, Jun 2, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Chet Holmgren
item.description:
Thunder coach Mark Daigneault said.

“We didn't get outscored by much when he was on the court. I can take some responsibility for [Holmgren's lack of shot attempts], but I still think he played a big-time game in some areas.”

Mark Daigneault on Chet Holmgren, May 31, 2026. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Chet Holmgren
item.description:
SGA on Chet Holmgren:

“He was really good. Chet has all the tools and everybody in our building and the league knows that. He’s a hell of a player. I don’t ever worry about Chet. I’ll bet on Chet 10 times out of 10.”

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Chet Holmgren, May 26, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: DeMarcus Cousins on Chet Holmgren
item.description:
“I put this [Game 1 loss] on Chet [Holmgren]. You have to step up and accept that challenge... he tucked his tail.”

DeMarcus Cousins on Chet Holmgren, May 19, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Victor Wembanyama, Chet Holmgren
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on what he saw when Chet Holmgren defended Victor Wembanyama during Game 1:

“Everything is on the table. You can’t just throw one pitch throughout the whole series. We have reasons why we approached the game the way we did last night. Some of that was the regular-season matchups. Some of that was the stuff we saw in the first couple of rounds from ourselves and from them. But in these series, one of the things you’ve got to do is you’ve got to figure out what the problems are and you’ve got to put the fires out pretty quickly. That’s our challenge, and we got to work on that with the team today. We’ll continue to work on it tomorrow, and then we’ll throw our best pitch tomorrow night.”

Mark Daigneault on Victor Wembanyama, Chet Holmgren, May 19, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Chet Holmgren
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on Chet Holmgren:

“One of the most underrated things about him as a defender is his versatility.”

Mark Daigneault on Chet Holmgren, May 5, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Chet Holmgren
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on Chet Holmgren:

“He was a dominant defensive player tonight.. It was a great overall game for him.”

Mark Daigneault on Chet Holmgren, Dec 28, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Dirk Nowitzki on Chet Holmgren
item.description:
Dirk Nowitzki did not hide his annoyance with Victor Wembanyama’s comments while speaking as a panelist Saturday on the Spurs-Thunder pregame show.

“I do want to say, I didn’t love his answer about Chet Holmgren,”

Dirk Nowitzki on Chet Holmgren, Dec 14, 2025. Source: Larry Brown Sports.

item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Chet Holmgren
item.description:
SGA on if Chet Holmgren can reach new levels:

“Everyone in the world who watches basketball knows Chet isn't even a fraction of the player he's going to be.. He's made to play basketball.”

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Chet Holmgren, Sep 29, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Isaiah Hartenstein, Chet Holmgren
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on revisiting the Holmgren-Hartenstein starting lineup:

“We keep everything fluid for a reason so that it’s not these seismic events when we change a lineup at any point in time. We changed the starting lineup during the season, coming out of halftime. We changed the rotation almost nightly in the regular season and playoffs. We try to normalize that for situations where we can be opportunistic.”

Mark Daigneault on Isaiah Hartenstein, Chet Holmgren, May 25, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Chet Holmgren
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Mark Daigneault on Chet Holmgren’s 4th quarter:

“He was big time. I don’t think he played his best in the first half, like a lot of guys didn’t…He was really ready to rock when he went back in there.”

Mark Daigneault on Chet Holmgren, May 21, 2025. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Chet Holmgren
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on Chet Holmgren’s play in his return:

“I just think he’s a great competitor. He’s got great fire…That’s what makes him great, in addition to the talent…”

Mark Daigneault on Chet Holmgren, Feb 10, 2025. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Chet Holmgren
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on Chet Holmgren’s return:

“I thought he showed great maturity…He showed great respect for the team.. He came out, he didn’t try to assert himself… he showed he’s a great teammate.”

Mark Daigneault on Chet Holmgren, Feb 8, 2025. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Chet Holmgren
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on the team’s resilience playing without Chet Holmgren:

“Chet’s a big part of who we are and what we’re doing. I can’t wait to have him back…The team’s just risen to the challenges and done it collectively.”

Mark Daigneault on Chet Holmgren, Dec 29, 2024. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Isaiah Hartenstein on Chet Holmgren
item.description:
“Just knowing that he (Chet Holmgren) can play at the four, too, (appealed to me),”

Isaiah Hartenstein on Chet Holmgren, Nov 26, 2024. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Chet Holmgren
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on Chet Holmgren’s improvement:

“Insatiable drive and ambition.. He is relentless.. Improvement is a skill.. He’s only going to get better.. So that’s exciting.”

Mark Daigneault on Chet Holmgren, Oct 27, 2024. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Sam Presti on Chet Holmgren
item.description:
Sam Presti on Chet Holmgren:

“I went to watch Gonzaga practice. Here's this big name recruit. Clearly going to go high in the draft. It's later in the season. I just wanted to see him interact.. He interacted with those guys like he was the 15th guy. That's part of what makes him a special player.”

Sam Presti on Chet Holmgren, May 28, 2024. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Chet Holmgren
item.description:
Clemente Almanza:Mark Daigneault:

“This is the lowest level of Chet Holmgren we're gonna see. Which is pretty exciting... He sleeps in his sneakers. He'll have a great summer.”

Mark Daigneault on Chet Holmgren, May 19, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Chet Holmgren
item.description:
“The year he got drafted... we played some pick up... and he [Chet Holmgren] was battling physically... I knew Chet had that fire in him”

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Chet Holmgren, Apr 25, 2024. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Chet Holmgren
item.description:
Clemente Almanza:Mark Daigneault on Chet Holmgren’s limited playing time in the 4Q against the Rockets:

“We were losing. I wanted to go small and try to shake it up there.”

Mark Daigneault on Chet Holmgren, Dec 8, 2023. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Rudy Gobert on Chet Holmgren
item.description:
Joel Lorenzi:Rudy Gobert on Chet Holmgren:

“The sky is the limit. He’s gonna write his own legacy,and I’m excited to witness that.”

Rudy Gobert on Chet Holmgren, Nov 28, 2023. Source: Twitter.

item.title: JJ Redick on Chet Holmgren
item.description:
Clutch Points:JJ Redick:

“I'm gonna ask you a serious question and I mean this in a positive way about Chet [Holmgren]: Is he an a*shole?”

JJ Redick on Chet Holmgren, Nov 2, 2023. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Chet Holmgren
item.description:
SGA on his pairing with Chet Holmgren:

“It’s gonna be very fun. We both have weapons that we can add and make each other’s games easier. The more we get better at it, the faster we get better at it, the better the team will be.”

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Chet Holmgren, Oct 4, 2023. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Sam Presti on Chet Holmgren
item.description:
Sam Presti on Chet Holmgren's offseason plans:

“Just keep progressing... See how he continues to do. He's moving onto 5v5 play... He's in a great spot in terms of what he was able to accomplish.”

Sam Presti on Chet Holmgren, Apr 20, 2023. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Chet Holmgren
item.description:
SGA on Chet Holmgren:

“The kid wants to be good. And I think that’s the biggest thing. He wants to be really good. He wants to prove himself to the world. And that fire in him is impressive. And I think he’s gonna be a heck of a basketball player. I 100% believe that.”

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Chet Holmgren, Apr 15, 2023. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Chet Holmgren
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on Chet Holmgren removing his boot:

“His recovery is not behind or ahead of what's normal. It's going very well. You're going to see him do more and more as time goes on. He's doing a great job of it... He should be really proud the way he's (rehabbing) so far.”

Mark Daigneault on Chet Holmgren, Nov 14, 2022. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.
